roadmap.metadataAndCanonicalStrategy: Keep one canonical per indexable route, with hub-specific title and description generated from approved hub metadata.
roadmap.uniqueHubCopyStrategy: Add concise, human-written hub support sections that match each hub intent and stay below or beside the browsing experience.
roadmap.openGraphAndPinterestStrategy: Plan social preview images after full CDN media is verified on the production custom asset domain.
roadmap.jsonLdStrategy: Add structured data only where accurate and useful, after content and asset URLs are stable.
roadmap.sitemapStrategy: Keep Phase 1 hub routes in the standard sitemap; add image sitemap only after full uploaded media and custom asset domain verification.
roadmap.adsenseQualityRisk: Avoid thin pages by pairing gallery-first UX with unique, useful supporting copy, clear navigation, and working media.
roadmap.contentPlacement: Keep gallery access near the top and move SEO-supporting copy below the gallery or into secondary browse sections.
roadmap.visualRules: Use the locked design system only. No nested cards, shadows, borders, outlines, gradients, or random colors.
roadmap.pinterestSupport: Prepare later sharing affordances only after stable public asset URLs and preview assets are verified.
roadmap.beforeAdsenseApplication: Verify live production media, ad spacing, content uniqueness, crawlability, privacy pages, contact/about pages, and policy-safe ad placement.
